summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with cough, wheezing, and low-grade fevers during cycle 14 of lenalidomide/bortezomib/dexamethasone for relapsed multiple myeloma. He had a history of hypogammaglobulinemia and recent transfusion. Initial evaluation showed no acute findings on chest X-ray, negative respiratory viral panel, and inconclusive sputum culture. He was treated with levofloxacin for suspected bronchitis and received IV immunoglobulin for immune support. His respiratory symptoms improved with bronchodilators, and he remained afebrile. Blood cultures remained negative at discharge. He was discharged home on a short course of antibiotics and new inhalers for ongoing wheezing, with plans to resume oncology treatment after recovery.
